decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no first project, no invite, no milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:0090d615, email:562d8cc2) and no tickets filed — no signal of engagement. Starter plan, 8 days left. Unaided self-activation unlikely but not impossible.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Following up on my note last week — no reply needed if things are moving. If it's helpful, I'm happy to help you get a first project set up with your real tasks. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that one step tends to make everything else fall into place. There's also an in-app onboarding flow that walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week work? Happy to walk through it with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Priya
